front.title: IOAM Extensions for On-Path Delay Measurement

abstract.t:
This document defines extensions to In Situ Operations, Administration, and Maintenance (IOAM) that enable IOAM nodes to compute on-path delay samples. These samples are the basis for the on-path delay statistics that can be exported using the IP Flow Information Export (IPFIX) Information Elements defined in RFC 9951.
The document defines an On-Path Delay IOAM data field and extends the IOAM Direct Export (DEX) Option-Type with a timestamp reference inserted by the IOAM encapsulating node. These extensions enable transit and decapsulating nodes to compute and locally aggregate on- path delay. The resulting on-path delay can then be made available by different mechanisms, for example IPFIX export or the YANG data model for on-path telemetry.
